facts.statement: Ten Ton Hammer ran a giveaway in which readers could enter to win a closed beta key for Free Realms.
facts.quote: you can enter to win a closed beta key for Free Realms

facts.statement: A Ten Ton Hammer Premium Member note on the page said Premium members in good standing would receive 100 chances to win a beta for Free Realms. A later commenter called the Free Realms reference a typo.
facts.quote: Current Ten Ton Hammer Premium Members in good standing will receive 100 chances to win a beta for Free Realms!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms Beta Giveaway
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer contest post offering closed beta keys for Free Realms during its closed beta period in April 2009. It describes the game as free to play, with optional subscription or one-time purchases for extra content, and asks testers to report bugs and give feedback during server stress tests. It gives no quest, item or price details.

article_summaries.title: LOTRO Anniversary Giveaway
article_summaries.summary: This Ten Ton Hammer news post is a contest announcement for a Lord of the Rings Online collector's edition and does not describe Free Realms. The only Free Realms mention is a sentence in the page's Premium Member note, which says Premium members would get 100 chances to win a Free Realms beta. A commenter then questioned that line and a reply called it a typo, so the rebuild should not treat it as confirmed.
